description: This routine is designed to manage an oily scalp and promote a healthy hair texture.
frequency: Daily for morning steps, weekly for night steps, monthly for deep cleansing treatments
estimated_time: 20-30 minutes per day, with additional time for deep cleanses once a month

morning_steps.action: Gently massage the scalp and hair with a light shampoo designed for oily scalps.
morning_steps.purpose: To cleanse excess oil and dirt without stripping natural oils.

night_steps.action: Apply a clarifying scalp treatment or mud mask to the scalp before bedtime.
night_steps.purpose: To absorb excess oil and soothe the scalp overnight.

weekly_steps.action: Deep condition your hair with a hydrating mask to restore moisture balance.

do: Use a wide-tooth comb to detangle hair gently.
Avoid excessive heat styling and tight hairstyles which can exacerbate oil production.
dont: Rinse your hair thoroughly when shampooing to ensure all product is removed.
Over-wash your hair as it can lead to overproduction of sebum, making the scalp oilier.
common_mistakes: Ignoring the need for deep cleanses and relying solely on daily washes.
Using too many styling products which can block pores and increase oiliness.

expected_results.2_weeks: Reduced oil production, improved scalp health.
expected_results.1_month: Balanced hair and scalp with reduced greasiness during the day.
expected_results.3_months: Sustained improvement in hair texture and scalp condition.

expert_tips: Regular scalp massage can improve blood circulation and help manage sebum levels.
Stay hydrated as dehydration can lead to an overproduction of oil by the scalp.
